articles.summary: BOULDER, Colorado—August 3, 2021 — OnKure, Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering a novel Class-1 selective histone deacetylase inhibitor for the treatment of solid tumor cancers, today announced the appointment of James Winkler, Ph.D. and Duncan Walker, Ph.D. as Chief Scientific Officer and Chief Development Officer, respectively. Dr. Winkler brings over 35 years of experienceRead More
articles.title: OnKure Expands Executive Team with the Addition of Chief Scientific Officer and Chief Development Officer
